featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this salon to get my nails done with a friend, based on a recommendation. Unfortunately, the experience was quite disappointing. First, the nail technician attending to me, Sejal, was adamant about doing acrylic nails despite me clearly communicating my preference for gel nails because I dislike the smell of acrylic. After much back-and-forth, she finally agreed to do gel nails, but the application was subpar. It was unevenly applied, and the filing and finishing were unsatisfactory.

Additionally, when my friend and I tried to understand the pricing discrepancy between the salon and the LUZO app during billing, the receptionist, whose name I cannot recall, was extremely rude and unwilling to explain politely or kindly. Despite our insistence on being treated with patience and respect, she found it difficult to do so.

While Sejal may improve her skills with time, the receptionist's behavior was unacceptable and has deterred us from returning to this salon. Her rudeness made us feel disrespected and devalued as customers. A salon should prioritize providing a pleasant experience, which was unfortunately lacking during our visit.

When I came to India, my friend told me I should try hair oil treatment and a head massage. Around tourist areas, though, I noticed many spas and salons tend to overcharge and aren’t very transparent with pricing. Then we found this salon — it offers a wide range of services from facials and massages to hair treatments. It’s not a fancy, cozy spa, more of a busy local salon full of regular customers, but I was really touched by the warmth and professionalism of the ladies there, so I wanted to leave a review.

I had coconut oil applied to my scalp along with a scalp massage, and it was incredibly relaxing — honestly one of the best scalp massages I’ve ever had. At the same time, I also got a foot massage going all the way up to my thighs. The therapist, Lata, really knew exactly where to focus. My legs feel so much lighter now, and she was very sweet, constantly checking if I was comfortable. Even with the language barrier, I could tell she genuinely cared and did her absolute best. I’m actually going to miss her — hands down the best foot massage I’ve ever received.

I also tried a hair booster treatment, and my hair finally feels calmer and much less frizzy.

This place may not have the most luxurious seating or spa atmosphere, but the people working here truly make the experience special. Their kindness, effort, and professionalism made it such a memorable visit.

I am giving 2 stars only because of Sanika, the stylist, who genuinely felt bad about what happened and tried her best to help by squeezing my mom in for a haircut. Sarika also tried to assist with my blow-dry while I waited. Unfortunately, the manager was least bothered. Even when the stylists requested Preeti to see if something could be done, she simply ignored it.

Luckily, I found another salon nearby and managed to get my service done. But this kind of behaviour, especially from a manager, is unacceptable. Very unprofessional and a really bad experience overall.

featured_reviews.name: Cyrus Doodhmal
featured_reviews.review_text:
In a noble quest to earn those ever-elusive husband brownie points, I agreed to accompany my wife to Butterfly Pond Boutique Salon. This much-buzzed-about spot in South Bombay’s (SoBo) beauty scene is tucked away at Usha Sadan, Shop No. 1, right next to the Colaba Post Office. Promising a touch of pampering and luxury, it sounded like the perfect opportunity to make my wife happy (and rack up some “best husband” credentials).

The journey started off promising, with a breezy cab ride to Colaba. But the final stretch to the salon turned into a real-life version of Survivor. Think puddles, rogue chai stains, and paan spit markings so artistic they could rival street murals. I briefly questioned my life choices, but my wife reassured me with a smirk: “It’s the destination that matters, darling.” Easy for her to say.

While my wife was promptly ushered in for her blow-dry session, I decided to kill some time by strolling down Colaba Post Office Road, where nostalgia hit me like a kulfi on a summer day. There it was—an old milk stall from my childhood, now transformed into an air-conditioned sweet mart. I couldn’t resist stepping in, treating myself, and boring the shopkeeper with tales of the good old days. Feeling both old and satisfied, I returned to the salon.

Stepping inside Butterfly Pond was like stumbling into a parallel universe. Gone was the chaos outside; in its place was a tranquil oasis of modern interiors, soft lighting, and muted tones that screamed “zen.” I awkwardly parked myself in a plush lounge chair, only to spot another guy also caught in the waiting-game trap, flanked by his two boys. Misery, it turns out, loves company. We exchanged knowing nods—the universal signal of “we’re in this together, mate.”

The staff at Butterfly Pond? Absolute legends. A stylist walked up to us, flashing a smile that could melt butter, and kindly offered tea or coffee. She even pretended not to notice how out of place I looked, which I appreciated. Meanwhile, Ali Askari (my new BFF in salon purgatory) and I couldn’t help but joke about how we’d definitely be back… if only to stay in our wives’ good books a little longer.

As for cleanliness, Butterfly Pond nailed it. Every tool was sanitized, every surface spotless. My wife—who treats cleanliness as the Eighth Wonder of the World—was visibly impressed. I mentally bookmarked that moment, knowing it would come in handy for future arguments.

Now, let’s address the elephant in the room: the infamous entrance path. Honestly, it’s less “welcome to luxury” and more “watch your step.” But hey, once you’re inside, it’s smooth sailing. Whether you’re there for a transformation or just playing the supportive spouse, Butterfly Pond delivers on every front.

We walked out with my wife looking fabulous and me basking in the glow of newfound husband points. In other words, a highly successful mission.

🌟 Rating: 4.7/5 (minus 0.3 for the obstacle course outside—stay nimble, folks).

featured_reviews.name: Izza Ishak
featured_reviews.review_text:
If I could give a ZERO star rating, I would. I AM NEVER COMING BACK.

I went to this salon for the second time to do a root touch up service and didn’t check the price list cause I don’t remember it to be too expensive. But when I was seated down and told them I wanted to do root touch and a treatment, the guy who did my hair said it’s 2k rupees. The lady at the door (The pudgy lady) came to me and quoted me 4K rupees saying that my grey hair is long so they are charging me 4K rupees. (Fine I accepted that though I think it was probably about 5cm long)

I agreed and she quoted me a 4.8k hair treatment or a 2.8k scalp treatment. I decided to take the scalp treatment and to my horror, my hair didn’t come out the way I expected it to be. I told them I would like to cover my grey hair and for it to blend seamlessly with the rest of my hair.

The guy who did my hair not only STAINED my first time use expensive teeshirt with dye, he tried to clean it for me which made it worst!
And all they said was ‘sorry maam’ and no compensation or refunds was offered at all 😒 it’s really not my problem you did not carefully cover my top when you use hair dye.

Secondly, I left the salon and realised my hair was a shit show! I have done many root touch ups in Bombay and this was the worst EXPENSIVE one ever!

They have used the INOA dye on me (which didnt come off well) and of course, the more pricier one. You can see on the price list below.

I got so mad seeing my hair and paying 6k plus rupees and came back to get them to do something about it. And they offered to redye my roots.

I wasted my time in India (all in all about 5 hours drama) and not only that, had to dye my roots TWICE ( and causing my scalp to itch till now). They probably used the 1.8k Majirel dye cause it is more darker and covers my grey hair proper after.

I NEVER WOULD HAVE THOUGHT I WOULD GET CHEATED (probably because I was not local) WHEN ALL I WANTED WAS AN EASY ROOT TOUCH UP.

Such regret going to this salon.

I would like to sincerely appreciate Aman for his exceptional professionalism and dedication toward his clients.

His approach to work is highly client-centric. He takes the time needed to ensure the best possible outcome, never compromising on quality for the sake of speed or convenience. His patience, attention to detail, and courteous nature make the entire experience extremely comfortable and reassuring.

Beyond being a highly skilled hair stylist, Aman has excellent customer relationship skills. He is considerate of his clients’ time, communicates well, and demonstrates a level of professionalism that is rare to find.

What also impressed me was his in-depth knowledge of his craft whether it is understanding hair texture, condition, suitability of treatments, or overall hair care. It is evident that he possesses strong technical expertise and genuine passion for his work.

I would strongly encourage his employer, Looks Salon, to continue investing in his professional development and advanced skill enhancement, as this would not only support Aman’s career growth but also add significant value to the organization.

What I personally learned from this experience is that sometimes people do far more for us than we realize behind the scenes. Aman’s commitment reminded me how important it is to respect others’ time and effort had I been late or canceled without notice, I would have overlooked the personal effort he made to honor my booking.

Aman is not only talented at what he does, but also a genuinely committed and dependable professional. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for both skill and exceptional service.
